### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the change to omit empty TypeScript registration guards. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #8303 by omitting empty registration guards from generated TypeScript client constructors, avoiding TS2774 errors when serializers or deserializers are disabled. **Changes:** - Emit each registration block only when its module list is populated. - Cover all four serializer/deserializer combinations while preserving registration calls and backing store arguments. - Document the fix in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​Kiota.Builder.Tests/​Writers/​TypeScript/​CodeFunctionWriterTests.cs` | Tests enabled and disabled registration combinations. | | `src/​Kiota.Builder/​Writers/​TypeScript/​CodeFunctionWriter.cs` | Skips registration blocks for empty module lists. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the TypeScript strict-compilation fix. |
Review effort: Balanced
